---
title: "Listening examples"
subtitle: "The example presets, rendered offline"
---

Each example is 16 bars at 120 BPM of generated test material (see [Offline tools](reference/offline-tools.qmd)),
processed by the engine with one of the presets in `presets/examples/`. Most are **echo only** (dry off), so what
you hear is only what memory returns. The *style change* input plays one style for 8 bars, then another, which
shows how memory handles the new material.

These are also in the plug-in's preset menu under **Examples**; settings shown with `@` change at that bar during
the render (the plug-in ignores those).
